top_signals.title: Gold Slumps to Seven-Week Low in ‘Extremely Tough’ Market
top_signals.summary: Gold sank to its lowest in more than seven weeks as the standoff between US and Iran over the Strait of Hormuz kept energy costs elevated and reinforced pressure on the Federal Reserve for more interest-rate hikes.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Citi expands Coinbase partnership to power stablecoin payments for businesses
top_signals.summary: Coinbase is expanding partnership with Citi to provide businesses with infrastructure connecting traditional fiat payments and stablecoins.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: UK’s Healey puts defense in focus for reindustrialization push
top_signals.summary: British government leaders are converging around the message that the defense sector will be key in energizing the nation's anemic growth.

top_signals.title: New Mexico jury finds Meta deceived consumers about data privacy practices
top_signals.summary: A New Mexico jury found Facebook violated the law nearly 44 million times by lying to consumers about its data privacy practices.
